name: TumorBoardCaseIntake
description: Form schema for the tumor board case prep app. All fields are free-text paste from EHR / path / NGS / imaging reports. The app sends this object to Granite for synthesis into a 1-page tumor-board card.

fields.label: Demographics + comorbidities
fields.placeholder: Age, sex, ECOG performance status, smoking history, key comorbidities. One short paragraph.
fields.example: 68F, never smoker, ECOG 1. PMHx: T2DM (well-controlled, A1c 6.8), prior PE on apixaban, osteopenia.

fields.label: Diagnosis + staging
fields.placeholder: Cancer type, histology, initial stage (TNM/AJCC), date of diagnosis, current stage if different.
fields.example: NSCLC, adenocarcinoma. Initial stage IIIB (T3N2M0) diagnosed Sept 2024. Currently stage IV (new liver and bone mets, April 2026).

fields.label: Pathology report
fields.placeholder: Paste relevant pathology report excerpts. Include initial biopsy and any re-biopsy.

fields.label: Molecular / NGS
fields.placeholder: Paste NGS report excerpts. Include initial profile and any repeat / liquid biopsy.

fields.label: Recent imaging
fields.placeholder: Paste most recent imaging report(s). Include comparison to prior if available.

fields.label: Treatment timeline
fields.placeholder: Chronological bullets: surgeries, chemo regimens with cycles, radiation, targeted/IO, response at each step.

fields.label: Current clinical status
fields.placeholder: Current symptoms, recent CBC/CMP/tumor markers, current performance status, anything new since last visit.

fields.label: Question for the board
fields.placeholder: What decision does the presenter want the board to make? Be specific.
fields.example: Next-line systemic therapy for EGFR-mutant NSCLC progressing on osimertinib with newly detected MET amplification. Specifically: role of MET inhibitor combination vs platinum-based chemotherapy + IO.

validation.graceful_degradation: If molecular field is empty, output should still be valid; the considerations section should note that molecular profiling may inform decisions if not yet performed.
